ContactPerson.name: Contact Person
ContactPerson.definition: Identification of the contact person by its name, given name and address.

EmployingParty.name: Employing Party
EmployingParty.definition: Identification of the organisation which is represented by the person or for which the person works.

PlaceOfListing.name: Place Of Listing
PlaceOfListing.definition: Identification of the financial market, as stipulated in the norm ISO 10383 'Codes for exchanges and market identifications'.
